title: Zach Bryan, Megan Moroney & Treaty Oak Revival Set for Return of GoldenSky Festival in 2027
summary: Following a 2-year hiatus, the Northern California festival has a deal in place for annual events 2027-29.
body: After a two-year hiatus, the GoldenSky Festival will return to Northern California in 2027, bringing more country music back to the West Coast when it hits Discovery Park in Sacramento on Oct. 9-10, 2027. Zach Bryan , Megan Moroney , Treaty Oak Revival, Ty Myers, Whiskey Myers, Hudson Westbrook, Max McNown and more are on the lineup, which also features Wyatt Flores, Vincent Mason, Avery Anna, Braxton Keith, Blake Whiten, Waylon Wyatt, Mack Geiger, Kaitlin Butts, Carter Faith, Alexandra Kay, Noah Rinker, The Band Perry, Tyler Nance, Graham Barham, Los Hermanos Mendoza and Fey Fili. Related Zach Bryan Sets His ‘Manhood’ Tour for 2027 Lola Young Praises Chappell Roan's Trick for Private Conversations: 'As You F–king Should, B—h' Here Are Taylor Swift's Likely Grammy Competitors for Best Song Written for Visual Media The 2027 edition is the first in a three-year commitment that will bring GoldenSky Festival back to Sacramento for 2027, 2028 and 2029. title: The Oura Ring 3 Horizon in Gold just got an $80 price drop
summary: Amazon drops the Oura Ring Gen 3 Horizon in Gold to $269.99, a solid price for this polished smart ring with sleep tracking.
body: Amazon has cut the Oura Ring Gen 3 Horizon in Gold to $269.99, $80 off its $349.99 retail price. That works out to a 23% discount relative to the RRP, making this a strong chance to grab a premium smart ring for a lot less than usual. See the deal at Amazon
